      '@helmwright/fx-duration':

packages:

  '@helmwright/fx-duration@file:vendor/fx-duration':
    resolution: {directory: vendor/fx-duration, type: directory}

snapshots:

  '@helmwright/fx-duration@file:vendor/fx-duration': {}
EOF
